thumbnail_art_direction: CHARACTER LOCK: the KAO channel character exactly as in the identikit — bald round head, flat simple cartoon face, smooth skin, NO wrinkles, NO eye bags, simple round eyes with black pupils, thick black outlines, LONG-SLEEVE top in vivid intense magenta #FF1A9C, dark grey trousers, no backpack. SCENE: show the exact situation of the video title IN ACTION, with every person the title talks about (a title about siblings shows the siblings, a title about parents shows the parents). If the topic is about childhood or something lived as a child, draw KAO as a CHILD (same bald round head, same face, same magenta long-sleeve top, small child body) doing the action with the others, e.g. playing with or taking care of a little brother. The character is always DOING something, never just sitting and staring. Other people: same flat cartoon style, simple faces, clothes in muted colors, never magenta. Characters LARGE in the LEFT 55% of the frame, framed from the knees up, faces big; one single continuous scene, never split into panels. NO text, NO letters, NO symbols, NO frames with people, NO papers with writing.

A real place (bedroom, kitchen, living room, park, school) with only a few essential props, evenly lit, natural warm colors, NOT a plain or magenta background. The characters stand in the LEFT 55% of the frame, LARGE: framed from the knees up, the main character's head in the upper third, faces big and clearly readable. thumbnail_art_direction: Wide eye-level photograph taken from the middle of a main street or residential road in a small American town, the road leading straight into the distance (one-point perspective). Clear blue sky with a few clouds, bright natural daylight, saturated colours. The town tells the story of the video: well kept and beautiful for positive topics; worn, empty or run-down for negative ones (faded paint, boarded windows, empty lots, a few local residents standing or sitting outside at medium distance, like in a real street photo). Vary the place: dirt or cracked roads, wooden or brick houses, desert towns, pastel Florida homes, autumn trees. Never weapons, police, crime scenes or close-up portraits. The TOP third of the frame is open sky, reserved for the title text. No text, no readable signs, no logos, no watermark.
